name: Derivatives Trade Reconciliation Statistical Report V 03
definition: The DerivativesTradeReportReconciliationStatisticalReport message is sent by the trade repositories to the reporting counterparty, to report cumulative information within the reference period for the reconciliation status of the reported and outstanding derivatives.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured fields and/or any other specific block.
